name: v46_fast_news_sentiment_low_relevance_noise
hypothesis: Fast-d1 news sentiment averaged from vector events may capture immediate story tone while novelty/relevance noise is penalized with low market beta relief.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_ssc_fast_d1), 45), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_qep_fast_d1), 45), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(nws18_relevance_fast_d1), 45), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: Uses news18 VECTOR fields via vec_avg; avoids news12 event-input direct ranking.

name: v46_fast_news_ma_positive_calm
hypothesis: Fast M&A sentiment and granular event sentiment may matter when event relevance is not extreme and market correlation is stable.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_bam_fast_d1), 45), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_ssc_fast_d1), 45), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(nws18_event_relevance_fast_d1), 45), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_60_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: Tests fast M&A vector event tone instead of old rp_nip_mna matrix.

name: v46_fast_earnings_eval_no_earnings_matrix
hypothesis: Fast-d1 earnings evaluation vector may differ from the crowded mean_earnings_evaluation_sentiment matrix because it is event-level and shorter horizon.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_bee_fast_d1), 45), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_ssc_fast_d1), 45), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(story_event_record_count_fast_d1), 45), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unsystematic_risk_last_60_days, 60), industry)
notes: Likely correlation risk vs RRpmOAWj; submit only if local daily-PnL corr is clean.

name: v46_fast_news_recommendation_change
hypothesis: News-detected analyst recommendation changes may differ from stale recommendation-level vectors if averaged and slowed.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(nws18_ghc_lna), 90), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_ssc_fast_d1), 45), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(nws18_relevance_fast_d1), 45), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: Distinct from weak v26 recommendation vector; uses news18 GHC change field.

name: v46_mean_mna_credit_legal_sentiment
hypothesis: A non-earnings event basket focused on M&A, credit ratings, and legal sentiment may be slower and more robust than the v41 broad non-earnings sentiment basket.
expression: 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_merger_acquisition_sentiment, 90), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_credit_ratings, 90), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_legal, 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_60_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 60), industry)
notes: Narrower than RRpbOXlg; no earnings/revenue/product news.

name: v46_buyback_authorization_yield
hypothesis: Authorized buyback amount relative to market cap may be a forward-looking shareholder-return signal distinct from realized buyback payments.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(authorized_stock_buyback_amount / cap, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(authorized_stock_buyback_amount / cap, 126), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(common_stock_shares_outstanding_count, 252) / common_stock_shares_outstanding_count, 126), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_60_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: Forward authorization, not common_stock_buyback_payments; high corr risk vs buyback ACTIVE.

name: v46_reacquired_shares_execution
hypothesis: Shares reacquired as a count and value may capture execution intensity through low-alphaCount footnote fields rather than the crowded payment field.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(shares_reacquired_during_period / common_stock_shares_outstanding_count, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(value_of_shares_reacquired_during_period / cap, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(common_stock_shares_outstanding_count, 252) / common_stock_shares_outstanding_count, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: Low-alphaCount repurchase execution fields; strict corr gate against 88zpWZ1X/MPpGzqwr.

name: v46_treasury_stock_accumulation
hypothesis: Treasury stock accumulation relative to shares outstanding may reflect sustained repurchase behavior, but should be slower and lower turnover than payment-flow factors.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(treasury_stock_share_count / common_stock_shares_outstanding_count, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(treasury_stock_share_count / common_stock_shares_outstanding_count, 252), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(authorized_stock_repurchase_amount / cap, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_60_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 60), industry)
notes: Treasury-stock accumulation path; may be sparse.
